scripts.build:local:zh: cross-env LOCAL_BUILD=true DOCUSAURUS_LOCAL_LOCALE=zh docusaurus build --out-dir build-local/zh && node scripts/strip-videos-postbuild.mjs build-local/zh zh && node scripts/generate-local-root-index.mjs build-local/zh zh
scripts.build:local:en: cross-env LOCAL_BUILD=true DOCUSAURUS_LOCAL_LOCALE=en docusaurus build --out-dir build-local/en && node scripts/strip-videos-postbuild.mjs build-local/en en && node scripts/generate-local-root-index.mjs build-local/en en
scripts.build:local:all: npm run build:local:zh && npm run build:local:en
scripts.tauri:dev:en: npm run build:local:en && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.en.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:zh: npm run build:local:zh && tauri build && node scripts/copy-tauri-exe.mjs zh
scripts.tauri:build:en: npm run build:local:en && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.en.conf.json && node scripts/copy-tauri-exe.mjs en
scripts.tauri:build:all: npm run tauri:build:zh && npm run tauri:build:en
